spotsheet.title: Industry Spot Sheets
spotsheet.summary: Every customer on the island: what it ships and receives, and which car goes on which spot. Interchange yards and the South Yard and dispatcher notes follow.

industries.name: Aristech Plastics
history: Founded 1986 as Aristech Chemical, spun off from U.S. Steel's USS Chemicals division with headquarters in Pittsburgh.
Major producer of acrylic sheet, molded plastics, and synthetic resins for bathtubs, spas, architectural panels, and packaging.
Continuous-cast acrylic sheet production began in 1969; chemical operations draw on the former USS Chemicals heritage dating to the 1960s.
industries.traffic: Plastic pellets (HC) and process chemicals (TA) in; plastic resins (XM) out. NVL serves the plant.

industries.name: A. Stucki Co.
history: Founded 1911 by Swiss engineer Arnold Stucki in the Pittsburgh area.
Stucki's roller side-bearing design stabilized freight cars and became a North American industry standard by the 1950s.
Grew through the 20th century as a supplier of railcar components, springs, bearings, and machined steel.
industries.traffic: Steel (FM/GA/XM) on the crane; general freight (XM/FM/GA) on the team track. Empties and outbound parts leave after spotting. NVL serves the plant.
spots: Boxcar, Flat Car, Gondola, Coil Car

industries.name: Calgon Carbon
history: Traces to 1942, when Pittsburgh Coke & Chemical developed coal-based activated carbon for U.S. military gas masks during World War II.
Pioneered granular activated carbon for municipal drinking-water treatment in the 1960s; headquartered in the Pittsburgh area.
Became an independent public company in 1987; one of the world's leading activated-carbon producers by the 1990s.
industries.traffic: Coal (HM) and process chemicals (TA) in; activated carbon (HC) out. NVL serves the plant.

industries.name: Ferrellgas
history: Founded 1939 as A.C. Ferrell Butane Gas Company in Atchison, Kansas.
James E. Ferrell took over in 1965 when the business had just four employees, then rebuilt it through Midwest propane dealer acquisitions.
Bulk propane storage and rail deliveries expanded through the 1970s and 1980s as residential and farm demand grew.
industries.traffic: LPG (TA) in at the unload racks; empty tanks out. NVL serves the plant.

industries.name: Kosmos Cement
history: Portland cement plant at Kosmosdale, Kentucky, shipping from the same site since 1905; founded by Samuel Horner Jr. as Kosmos Portland Cement Company.
Supplied cement for early Ohio River lock and dam construction; a fleet of company towboats with names beginning in “K” moved cement and quarry stone.
The company town of Kosmosdale grew around the mill; Horner heirs sold the operation in 1957 and the plant was rebuilt in the early 1970s.
industries.traffic: Cement (HC) and aggregate (HM/GA) in; empty hoppers out. NVL serves the plant.

industries.name: Shenango Coke Works
history: Pittsburgh Coke & Chemical (PC&C) was making coke and pig iron on the eastern end of Neville Island by 1929. The coke ovens and chemical works that later became Shenango date to about 1930.

PC&C was more than a coke plant: on the island it also made cement, industrial chemicals, and activated carbon. Those other branches became the Kosmos, Aristech, and Calgon operations still switched today.
In 1962 Shenango Furnace purchased PC&C. The coke-and-iron division became Shenango Inc. and kept making coke and coke by-products on the same site for decades after the PC&C name disappeared.
industries.traffic: HM coke on Shipping 1 and Shipping 2 (no numbered spots). CK1 lifts for South Yard scale. Loads to U.S. Steel Edgar Thomson Works (Braddock, PA) via CSX and LTV Steel Cleveland Works (Cleveland, OH) via POHC. NVL may set out deliveries; no Shenango empty pickup on the NVL return.
industries.spotNote: No numbered spots. Weigh all outgoing coke at South Yard scale.

offline.name: Scully Yard
about: POHC gateway. NVL takes its session-start block here. McKees Rocks-PA party tracks hold offline suppliers and customers.
Connections beyond the offline tracks are typically POHC and NS.
outbound: LTV Steel Cleveland Works (Cleveland, OH) — coke
jobs: NVL — assign/pickup session block at Scully, then run to South Yard.

offline.name: Demmler Yard
about: CSX gateway. D749 lifts its inbound block here at session start. McKeesport-PA party tracks hold offline suppliers and customers.
Connections beyond the offline tracks are typically CSX (URR territory historically adjacent at McKeesport).
outbound: U.S. Steel Edgar Thomson Works (Braddock, PA) — coke
jobs: D749 — pickup Demmler block → South Yard setout to open the session; later return from McKeesport side and terminate West Yard.

desk.name: South Yard
about: Session open / class yard. West Lead = SOUTH-SCALE (CK1 weigh at 4 MPH, stretch, no brakes). Exchange: Demmler/CSX off; Island/Shenango on.

lists.label: Trains this session
items: D749 (CSX turn): lift West Yard consist → Demmler pickup → South setout to open ops; interchange per YM; west when cleared.
D749: return from McKeesport; YM spots West or South; engine to terminal.
NVL (POHC Island local): Scully → South; interchange per YM; work Island industries + Shenango setouts.
NVL: finish Island/Shenango deliveries before return homebound. Final South interchange → Scully. Shenango deliver-only on return.
CK1 (Coke transfer): calibrate scale. Shenango: set out reloads, lift Shipping 1/2 coke → weigh West Lead → class. Imbalanced → reload orders.
CK1: same session, reloads South → Shenango when authorized.

lists.label: Blocking priority
items: D749 Demmler → South setout opens the session.
NVL South exchange before Island work.
Island/Shenango setouts before NVL return homebound assigns.
CK1 weigh/resort; reloads to Shenango when ready.
D749 return → West Yard.

desk.name: Dispatcher
about: Authorize road moves, keep train order, and protect the South Yard block exchange. Crews work from switch lists; yardmaster owns South class tracks.

lists.label: Territory
items: Scully Yard — POHC interchange (NVL start).
Neville Island / Shenango — NVL local; CK1 coke plant.
South Yard — class hub, session open, track scale (West Lead).
Demmler Yard — CSX interchange (D749 start / return).
West Yard — D749 overnight / terminate.

lists.label: Session sequence
items: D749: Demmler pickup → South setout opens ops; then west as cleared.
NVL: Scully block → South exchange → Island / Shenango work → return to Scully (Shenango deliver-only on return).
CK1: Shenango shipping → South scale → class; reloads back when ready.
D749 return from McKeesport → West Yard.

lists.label: Blocking priority
items: Hold NVL Island work until South has taken the D749 inbound setout and completed the block exchange.
Island / Shenango deliveries before NVL builds the homebound.
CK1 scale string clear of West Lead conflicts during weigh (4 MPH).
One road move at a time across shared leads when crews meet at South.

scale.title: Scale Operating Instructions
scale.summary: The scale is used to verify and log proper loading of outbound cars prior to departure from South Yard.

items: Bring the train to a complete stop well before the scale approach track.
Ensure all handbrakes are fully released and train air is completely cut in.
Begin the move by gently stretching out the entire string of cars.
The train must be 100% fully stretched (in draft) before the first car reaches the scale track.
Maintain this constant tension throughout the entire weigh run.
Maintain a strict, uniform speed between 3 and 5 MPH.
Avoid throttle adjustments, rapid acceleration, or drifting while cars are on the scale.
Do not use independent, dynamic, or automatic brakes during weighing.
All scale movements must be performed at restricted speed.
Never leave the Track Scale Terminal unattended while a car is under weigh.
Protect shove movements at all times.
Report scale failures or abnormal readings immediately.
Verify the scale is completely clear.
Open the Track Scale Terminal and select Calibrate mode.
Place the Scale Test Car on the LEFT sensor position and weigh the car.
Adjust the LEFT sensor until Error reads 0.00 tons, then lock the sensor.
Repeat for the CENTER and RIGHT sensor positions.
When all three sensors show zero error and the terminal indicates READY, select Save calibration.
Clear the scale and return the Track Scale Terminal to Weigh mode.
Return the Scale Test Car to South Yard.
Open the Track Scale Terminal and select Weigh mode.
Observe Section 1 movement rules, then spot the car on the scale.
Select the car from Cars at Scale / Inbound Train.
The terminal displays Adjusted Gross Weight and Net Load for the car on the scale.
PASS — Record the certified net weight. The car is within prescribed tolerance and approved for outbound movement.
REJECTED — Overload or left/right imbalance beyond prescribed tolerance; do not release the car.
Assign a reload order for return to the originating industry.
Rejected cars must not depart South Yard until reweighed and approved.

jobs.name: CSX Neville Island Switcher
jobs.title: Crew Instructions
jobs.summary: CSX turn between Demmler / McKeesport and Neville Island. The train starts tied down in West Yard. Deliver the Demmler inbound to South Yard, hostle the engine to the engine terminal, then return for the Demmler / McKeesport outbound block, depart westbound, and terminate again in West Yard.
steps: Find the train tied down in West Yard with the inbound Demmler block.
Obtain dispatcher clearance and run the inbound to South Yard.
Set out the Demmler / McKeesport inbound at South Yard.
Take the engine light to the engine terminal. Top off fuel and sand if needed.
When called for the outbound, interchange with the Yardmaster. Build and lift the Demmler / McKeesport outbound block.
With clearance, depart toward McKeesport with the outbound block.
On return, follow Yardmaster instructions and tie down in West Yard. Secure the engine.

talk.why: Clearance for the inbound run and the outbound departure.
Interchange at South Yard, the outbound block, and where to tie down.

jobs.name: Neville Island Turn
jobs.title: Crew Instructions
jobs.summary: Neville Island turn from Scully Yard. Interchange at South Yard, work Neville Island industries, then return to McKees Rocks / Scully with the outbound block.
steps: Assign on the train at Scully Yard with the inbound Scully block.
Obtain dispatcher clearance and run to South Yard.
Interchange with the Yardmaster. Lift the local industry cut.
Work Neville Island industries: Aristech, A. Stucki, Calgon Carbon, Ferrellgas, Kosmos Cement, and Shenango Coke Works.
Return to South Yard for final interchange. Lift the Scully / McKees Rocks outbound block.
With dispatcher clearance, depart for McKees Rocks / Scully Yard and secure.

talk.why: Clearance to South Yard and for the return to McKees Rocks / Scully.
Interchange at South Yard: the local cut out, the Scully block back.

jobs.name: Coke Transfer
jobs.title: Crew Instructions
jobs.summary: Shenango Coke Works pickup and delivery, scale calibration, weigh, and sort. Power is assigned by the Yardmaster.
steps: Report to the Yardmaster for the assigned engine before going to work.
Calibrate the track scale with the scale test car (see EQ-01 Scale Operating Instructions).
Handle Shenango Coke Works pickup and delivery as directed by the Yardmaster.
Weigh the coke pull on the South Yard west-lead scale at a steady stretch; do not apply brakes under weigh.
Sort and set out weighed cars in South Yard for classification.

talk.why: Your engine, Shenango pickups and deliveries, and where weighed cars go.
Clearance for road moves to and from Shenango.

jobs.name: Yardmaster Sequence
jobs.title: Yardmaster Sequence
jobs.summary: Keep South Yard organized: build cuts by color, hand work to each train in order, and keep D749, NVL, and CK1 from stepping on each other.

sequence.action: Receive inbound Demmler / McKeesport block, build and hand-off outbounds to D749.
Receive the Scully setout and give NVL the local cut for delivery.
Hand Shenango cars to CK1 for delivery; calibrate the scale, weigh coke pull and sort.
Receive NVL setouts and give the Scully / McKees Rocks block for the return.

talk.why: Interchange, cuts by color, and where each crew sets out and ties down.
When road moves will cross the shared leads at South Yard.

jobs.name: Dispatcher Train List
jobs.title: Dispatcher Train List
jobs.summary: Authorize road moves, keep train order, and keep freight out of the streetcar's way. Work the lineup in order and the priority strip when moves conflict.

lineup.action: Operate per timetable; hold conflicting work until the train clears.
Demmler → South Yard to open; interchange; release outbounds to McKeesport.
When scheduled — highest priority; clear the route.
Scully → South Yard; interchange; service local industries; return with outbounds; return to McKees Rocks.
Shenango pickup and delivery; calibrate scale, weigh coke pull, and sort.
Authorize return; terminate in West Yard.
Operate per timetable; hold conflicting work until the train clears.

talk.why: Clearance for road moves; one move at a time across the shared leads at South Yard.
When South Yard is ready for the next interchange.
